name: Improved Bond
body:
Your second mystic tie has grown as strong as your first.

Prerequisite: Character level 5, Second Bond, a “bond” class ability.

Benefit: Treat your class level as normal for all calculations related to your second bond, rather than treating it as three levels lower.
